supported_scope: MCP client for local stdio and remote servers, configured globally or per workspace and managed with /mcp; authentication by Google credentials, OAuth or custom headers; MCP tools governed by mcp(server/tool) permission rules and Ask by default.
required_setup: Configure an MCP server; none is included in the profile.

evidence.section: Getting started by surface > Antigravity CLI
evidence.quote: Antigravity CLI supports both local stdio processes and remote host MCP server configurations
unconfigured MCP tools run in Ask mode
